\pl{0.00}{[1 Tim. 1:15]\hspace{0.90em}This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation;}
\pl{2.40}{That Jesus Christ came into the world to save}
\pl{2.40}{sinners, of whom I am chief.}
\pl{0.00}{[Rom. 5:20]\hspace{0.90em}Where sin abounded, grace did much more}
\pl{2.40}{abound.}
\pl{1.20}{[Rom. 11:32]\hspace{0.90em}God hath concluded all under sin, that}
\pl{2.40}{He might have mercy upon all.}
\pl{1.20}{[Rom. 5:10]\hspace{0.90em}God commendeth His love toward}
\pl{2.40}{us, in that, while we were yet sinners, yea,}
\pl{2.40}{while we were His enemies, Christ died}
\pl{2.40}{for us.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Nor in vain the second Apostle,}
\pl{0.00}{[1 Pet. 3:18]\hspace{0.90em}Christ hath once suffered for our sins,}
\pl{4.80}{the just for the unjust, that He might bring us to God.}
\pl{0.00}{[Jas. 2:13]\hspace{0.90em}Mercy rejoiceth against judgment.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Nor in vain the fourth,}
\pl{0.00}{[1 John 2:2]\hspace{0.90em}If any man sin, we have an Advocate}
\pl{2.40}{with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous; and}
\pl{2.40}{He is the propitiation for our sins;}
\pl{3.60}{And not for ours only, but for}
\pl{2.40}{the sins of the whole world.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Nor in vain shalt Thou Thyself have said,}
\pl{0.00}{[Matt. 11:25]\hspace{0.90em}Come unto Me, all ye that labour and are heavy}
\pl{2.40}{laden, and I will refresh you.}
